Named Inflows (signature; form): settlement_grow (self; inflow, rate modified by hex.population); settlement_attract (self; conversion from target settlement)
Named Outflows (signature; form): settlement_attract (target; conversion to self settlement); engine_decay
Notes: Lifecycle anchor — settlement dies at 0. grow produces residents at a rate modified by hex.population abundance (hex not consumed, not gated). attract redistributes residents between settlements. faction_recruit reads residents without depleting.

Named Inflows (signature; form): npc_guard (target; conversion from NPC.satiety); faction_patrol (target; conversion from faction.influence)
Notes: Externally supplied by NPC guards (depletes satiety) and faction patrols (depletes influence). Depleted outward via settlement_garrison — security flows from settlement into containing region.regional_safety.
Earned via NPC deeds (create_works depletes ambition). Gates four downstream verbs: trade (→hex.wealth), attract and grow (resident targeting), artifact_enshrine (→artifact.containment).

Named Outflows (signature; form): settlement_propaganda (self/target; drift ↔ NPC); faction_indoctrinate (target; drift ↔ faction)
Rate Modulators (flow -> direction; form: settlement_propaganda (self/target; drift ↔ NPC); faction_indoctrinate (target; drift ↔ faction)
column13: Plane rows: 'Inflow'/'Outflow' = axis shift UP/DOWN. Settlement participates only in drift verbs (propaganda with NPCs, indoctrinate with factions). Shift direction depends on partner state. Ideology modulates attract VOLUME (how many residents move).
